article.title: The normality of evil: Reflections on the “NAZA” documentary
article.author: Editor
article.content: Hannah Arendt’s characterization of Eichmann as representing “The Banality of Evil,” the subtitle of her book Eichmann in Jerusalem, shocked many people. The post The normality of evil: Reflections on the “NAZA” documentary appeared first on MR Online .
